photos.use: two window axes of the canal front, portal column
portal soffit, black door, arched transom lights

notes: Gate-house pand only; BAG year 1775. The pand has 6.1 m of canal frontage and holds the south jamb of the portal at its north-west corner (the 1.6 x 1.1 m jog in the BAG ring, extruded by 3DBAG to 11-12 m); the gate opening and the north jamb are outside the pand ring.
decisions: Previous model put the portal across the whole 6.1 m front. The panoramas show the front is two window axes and the portal stands beside it, so the portal is now a stone screen north of the ring: rusticated north pier, two free-standing columns with flared volute capitals, an entablature with dentils, a segmental pediment with a cartouche, a finial urn, and a stone back plate carrying the black door and two arched transom lights.
The 3DBAG jamb walls are drawn in stone instead of brick.
Canal front: white sash windows (two columns, rows from height) on three floors at t = 1.55 and 4.15 m, brick-arch courses above, basement lights, floor band and white eaves cornice.

Inferred (no photograph): the passage-side (north) wall windows, the roof (3DBAG hip with flat top, no dormers modelled), the long blank south wall (a party wall in reality, flagged blank-wall by the audit as a warning).
